715477.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations, your current location and location B.
  • Make sure you are enrolled at both locations.
  • Have a work order, work order 1, made and invoiced at location B and not yet paid, and copy its link from the report: click Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" in the left menu; find work order 1's invoice row (its Location column names location B, for example "Staging Lethbridge - 4310"); right-click its invoice number and choose "Copy link address".
  • The copied link ends with "?locationId=" and location B's code. A link copied from the address bar has no location in it, so it is not the link this test uses.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • After the release is installed, click Work Orders in the top menu at your current location.
715477.custom_steps:
1. Paste the link to work order 1 into the address bar.
  2. Press Enter.
  3. Click "Cancel".
